governanceAuthority: SECP Engineering Truth & Forensic Verification Directorate

assemblyBrepInterferenceOCCT.strengths: Uses real OCCT WASM booleanIntersect and common operations to compute exact volumetric intersection and centroid.
assemblyBrepInterferenceOCCT.criticalDefects: Fail-open error handling (catches kernel exceptions and silently returns NO_INTERFERENCE); not bound to interactive viewport.

camCollisionDetectionEngine.strengths: Structured BVH broad-phase and continuous multi-step swept motion sampling.
camCollisionDetectionEngine.criticalDefects: Narrow phase tests only triangle vertices and centroid (omits edges/interior face cuts); UI runs exclusively on hardcoded synthetic demo triangles.

fiveAxisCAMCollisionEngine.strengths: Tool holder and spindle nose capsule geometry hierarchy.
fiveAxisCAMCollisionEngine.criticalDefects: Obstacle mesh faces are completely ignored (loops only over vertices); swept test only checks endpoints p0 and p1.

manufacturingCollisionDetector.strengths: Capsule-capsule analytical segment distance; clean fail-closed tolerance validation.
manufacturingCollisionDetector.criticalDefects: Narrow phase restricted to capsule and AABB (no triangle mesh or B-Rep support); capsule-AABB uses 10 discrete sample points.

assemblyClashNarrowPhaseSAT.strengths: Exact 15-axis SAT for OBBs and analytical sphere-sphere tests.
assemblyClashNarrowPhaseSAT.criticalDefects: Gate-only execution (HardAcceptanceGate032); cylinders and meshes silently fall back to bounding box tests.

kinematicCollisionClearanceBridge.criticalDefects: Hardcoded distance - 30.0 mock formula; no geometric CAD model consumption.
